newsitem.title: USA: Circuit City Stores March sales up 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Circuit City Stores March sales up 17 pct.

text.p: Circuit City Stores Inc on Friday said total sales rose 17 percent to $652.0 million last month from $555.1 million in March 1996.
For the Circuit City Group, total sales were $590.6 million, a 15 percent increase from March 1996 sales of $515.0 million. Comparable store sales fell one percent.
Total sales for the CarMax Group were $61.4 million, which represents a 53 percent increase from March 1996 sales of $40.1 million. Comparable store sales rose 34 percent.

"March sales for the Circuit City Group continued the improved trend that started in February, with accelerated sales in personal computers, major appliances and fully featured video products," said Richard L. Sharp, chief executive of Circuit City Stores.

"CarMax results reflect the consumer's overwhelming enthusiasm for our customer-friendly auto retailing concept," Sharp said. "The comparable store sales include growth at three locations with ages ranging up to three-and-a- half years and the Norcross, Ga., site, which also sells new cars."
